_note: All game tuning numbers live here (CLAUDE.md). Arrays marked 'by day' are indexed from day 1; days past the end reuse the last entry.
_maxActive: by day: most customers in line or waiting at once. A new one only comes once someone is served (after afterServeSec).

fry._note: Temperatures in °F. Doneness: 0 = raw dough, 1 = golden, ~1.5+ = dark.
fry._dough: A donut's fry score × (1 − doughEffect × (1 − its dough batch's quality)).

glaze._note: Coordinates are normalised to the donut (centre 0,0, edges ±1). Base coat: coverage/goodCoverage × (1 − spill/spillZeroAt). Drizzle: right amount × spread over the 8 balls × (1 − spill/spillZeroAt). Wrong glaze × wrongGlazeFactor.
glaze._boards: Donuts on the glazing tray at once.
glaze._pattern: Flavours with a drizzlePattern score the drizzle like a coat over those stripes: coverage of the stripes / patternGoodCoverage, minus spill off them (0 at patternSpillZeroAt × the stripes' size).

toppings._note: Pieces are placed in normalised donut coordinates. Per wanted topping: amount (menu topping.amount, too much is 0 at max × tooMuchZeroAtFactor) × evenness over the 8 balls × (1 − share that fell off / messZeroAt). Each unwanted topping multiplies by unwantedFactor.

scoring._note: Order score = weighted average of the station scores (0-100) and the wait score. Wait: full marks until patienceSec × graceShare, easing (cosine) to 0 at patienceSec × zeroShare. Tip = tip.perDonut × donuts × curve(order score), the curve is [score, multiplier] points joined by straight lines. Thanks tiers by order score.
scoring._gift: An extra donut (a real menu flavour) beyond the order is a gift: +tipPerDonut each (up to max), and the customer's reaction goes up tierBoost levels.

dough._note: Morning prep: scoop the recipe into the bowl, stir, and the batch fills the dough tub. The ingredient you have least of (relative to the recipe) sets how many donuts it makes: batchSize × that share (a double recipe makes twice as many; any missing ingredient makes none). Quality = 1 − scoopPenalty × (scoops off those proportions), at least qualityFloor. Each donut dropped in the fryer uses one.

deliveries._note: By day: morning batch orders for couriers (a coffee shop, a delivery app). They're on the rail from the start of the day; pickup patience is the delivery customer type's patienceSec.

events._note: A served walk-up customer may invite domochi to their event (chance by reaction tier, plus giftBonus if you gave them a gift). Accepting makes tomorrow a pop-up day (see events.json). At most one invite a day.

cleanup._note: Closing time: wipe both trays (mess at or below messDoneAt) and filter the oil. A tidy close earns tidyBonus. Oil dirt +1 per donut fried; the vat looks fully dirty at oilDirtMax. A tray not cleaned up stays dirty into the next day and grows mold (Kumar 2026-11-01): donuts made on it taste funky (no tip, unhappy customer), and after moldNoPayDays dirty days customers won't pay for them. Scrubbing it clean clears the mold. The dough bowl gets dirty with every batch; scrub round it bowlWashTurns times to wash it (part of a tidy close). Left dirty overnight it grows mold, and no dough can be mixed in it until it is washed.

day._note: With the full day (not the tutorial): the window is open for lengthSec. Walk-ups keep coming until then; when time's up, anyone still in line goes home, and the orders already taken still get served (or sent home). Days never run out. customersPerDay only applies without the full day (tests).

goals._note: A daily goal (full day only, from day 2): one of these, the same for a given day. Targets grow with the day (base + perDay × day, up to max). Meeting it pays reward (banked with the day's takings).

special._note: Special of the day (full day only): one flavour on today's menu, the same for a given day. It sells for priceBonus more per donut, and customers favour it like one of their favourites. From fromDay on.

streak._note: Good or great orders in a row: each one after the first adds tipPerOrder to the tip (× tip), up to maxBonus. An okay or bad order ends the streak.

payment._note: What a customer pays (share of the order price) by reaction tier (scoring.tiers): great and good pay full, okay pays okay, bad pays bad and leaves no tip. An order scoring below awfulBelow isn't paid for at all, and they take up to awfulTipJar back out of today's tip jar.

supplies._note: Stock: glazes and toppings (one serving per donut they go on),  dough ingredients (one per scoop), boxes (one per order served) and oil jugs (one per + oil). Bought in packs at the supply store after each day; prices swing up to priceSwing either way, day to day. start = what a new game begins with. Ethan's friends may drop off a pack of something running low (friendChance per check, every friendCheckSec, at most friendsPerDay). Glaze and topping items unlock (in the store) on their unlockDay, with the first flavour that uses them.

errand._note: When you're out of baking materials (Kumar 2026-11-01): after delaySec, one of Ethan's friends swings by. If you can pay for the supplies plus their fee (feeRate of the cost, at least feeMin), they offer a run to the store for enough dough for 'batches' batches; you can say no. If you can't afford it, they bring enough for rescueBatches, free. At most perDay a day, from day 1 (so you can never get stuck).

weather._note: Each day's weather (the same for a given day; day 1 is always firstDay), picked by weight. spawnFactor: × the gap between walk-ups (bigger = fewer). extraPickups: more morning delivery orders. heatLag: × how fast the oil reaches the dial. patience: × how long customers happily wait. tip: × tips. note: shown on the morning checklist. fixedDays: set weather for early days, so every kind shows up in the first week. icon: shown by the day on the ticket rail.

types.name: cloudy
types.note: cloudy and mild: folks are patient

types.name: hot
types.note: hot! the oil heats fast and nobody wants to wait

types.name: rainy
types.note: rainy: fewer walk-ups, more delivery orders

regulars._note: Named regulars (customers.json) come back day after day. chance: share of walk-ups who are a regular (if one is due). Friendship goes up with a good or great order and down with a bad one (0 to maxLevel). From usualAt they just say 'the usual!' and their order goes straight on the rail.

guides._note: Dashed guides, bought once at the supply store (the tutorial shows them all). Glaze station: 'base' is the loops for any base coat; a flavour id is that flavour's drizzle stripes. Toppings station: 'topping-<id>' is the ring that shows where to shake that topping (a topping without one listed here keeps a free ring).

box._note: Each ordered slot holding its flavour = 1, that flavour in the wrong slot = wrongSpotCredit, minus extraPenalty per extra donut that isn't a real flavour (extra real flavours are gifts, scored in scoring.gift).

decor._note: Decorations for the lot, from the supply store (bought once, from unlockDay). Each shows in the Lobby and gives a small perk: patience (× how long customers happily wait, +share), tip (+share of tips), spawn (× the gap between walk-ups: below 1 = more customers).

staff._note: Hire a crew (from each hire's unlockDay): they run the trailer while you're away. Money made away = cap × (1 − ½^(hours away / halfLifeHours)), where cap is the hires' capAdd added up: it levels off, so a long time away isn't worth much more than an evening. Nothing for under minHours away. The last to join is the player: mochi asks their name and invites them onto the team (free).

daily._note: mochi's daily gift (research, 2026-11-01: daily streak bonuses are the top reason mobile players come back). The first time you open the game each day: cash for day 1, 2, ... in a row, a 7-day cycle; missing a day just starts again.

trailerCode._note: The trailer's secret word (systems/trailerCode.ts): a word a week, shown at the real trailer; typing it in the game pays cash once a week. A sticker for the first visit, and another after regularVisits different weeks. Calendar for Ethan: npm run trailer-words.

weekly._note: The weekly challenge (systems/weekly.ts): one goal per real calendar week (Monday to Sunday), built up over the days played that week; reward when it's done. A reason to come back across the week.

sides._note: Kolaches and onigiri ride along with donut orders: once a kind is on the menu, an order gets some with this chance (count in range). Pickup orders get them pickupFactor × as often. Each kind goes in its own box (menu.json sides boxes, the smallest that fits). The order score mixes the donut part with each side's score by how many items each is.

starterKit._note: The first day a kind is on the menu, a starter kit of its supplies arrives (once per game).

bake._note: Bake station (kolaches). Hold-to-add amounts grow perSec while held (1 = just right): full marks inside ideal, 0 at zeroAt beyond. Proof rises perSec on the pan until it goes in the oven. Wash: one brush stroke across a kolache adds about 0.5. Oven like the fryer: the temperature eases to the dial (heatLagPerSec), cook rate 0 at zeroAtF and 1 at oneAtF, golden after secondsToGolden at rate 1; burntAt and it's thrown out. Score: weighted parts; temperature only counts as far as it came out golden; the wrong filling is 0.

rice._note: Rice station (onigiri). A pot takes cookSec and makes portions onigiri; its quality comes from the water level (1 inside ideal, qualityFloor at zeroAt beyond). Scoop: hold the paddle (1 = just right). Filling: distance from the middle, 0 centre to 1 edge. Press: count presses, each held idealSec; extras × extraFactor each. Nori: off-centre 0 to 1. The wrong filling is 0.
